description: Q12: the 33-question benchmark (3 questions x 11 types: coauthor breadth, max team size, direct collaboration, shortest paths, components, communities, bridge researchers, temporal change, topics, institutions, evidence) asked with real answers through POST /v1/query against the LOCAL stack, and scored on retrieval, claims and answer text against the computed answer key. User decisions 2026-11-16 (docs/agent-runs/phase-15/prompt.md): Q12 cannot be dropped; mode (b) with all 33 questions answered for real; run after P3 and P4 are fixed.

llm.draws_from: bucket 16b of the shared claude-haiku-5-5 cap USD 1.33 (experiments/manifests/llm-allocation.json): 33 answers x USD 0.001365 = USD 0.045045 estimated (not metered)
llm.prerequisite: bucket 16b holds 0 remaining answers after Session 1 (40 used); the human-approved transfer line APPROVED_LLM_TRANSFER=15b->16b:33 must be applied with load-tests/llm_budget.py transfer before the run (15b keeps 60 - 33 = 27 remaining answers, 16b becomes 33 remaining); this manifest never creates or applies an approval
llm.enforcement: load-tests/evalq12.py run charges bucket 16b itself (one ledger answer line before every request, under the ledger lock) and refuses to start when 33 exceed the bucket's remaining answers or the USD 1.33 total; do NOT also run llm_budget.py reserve --bucket 16b for it; the evidence and explain GET requests call no model
llm.key_handling: the writer needs a real Anthropic key; it is handled by the approved procedure of docs/agent-runs/phase-15 (Q12 key-handling approval), never by this manifest: only an environment variable of the one run process, never a CLI argument, shell tracing off (set +x)
llm.cost_reporting: AWS, Anthropic and Voyage reported as separate items, then the combined total; the local stack has no AWS charge from this run; Voyage tokens are counted inside the service

source.export_dir: target/phase15/p6/size-S/run:ba7402d1-959a-4277-8c6e-e92878a38afa/spark (git-ignored; the plain-CSV neptune-opencypher-csv sidecar is read, no Parquet)

types.coauthor_breadth: ranking by distinct coauthors (3 windows); exact key
types.max_team_size: ranking by maximum team size; all-years exact, two windowed questions bounded (the CSV sidecar has no work years)
types.direct_collab: direct coauthors of one researcher (one with 26 coauthors so the 25-row page truncates); exact key
types.component: component size and id; exact key
types.community: compare communities of one researcher; exact key from an independent port of the synchronous label propagation (validated against analytics-report.json); planner route LLM
types.bridge: ranking by cross-community degree (3 windows); exact key
types.temporal: did X change between adjacent stored windows; exact key except deltaAverageCoauthorsPerPaper and deltaMaximumCoauthorsOnOnePaper (not checked); planner route LLM
types.topic: THIN DATA (3 TOPIC nodes on one work with no AUTHORED edge): the key expects a verified abstention
types.institution: THIN DATA (1 INSTITUTION node, 0 AFFILIATED_WITH edges): the key expects a verified abstention
types.evidence: explain the research collaboration of one researcher (explain / SemanticExplanation form); structural key plus entity facts; planner route LLM

command.raw_results: target/experiment-runs/q12-benchmark-<run-id>/raw/ (answers.jsonl with the query answer, the /v1/explain body and every cited /v1/evidence item per question; events.jsonl, run-record.json, raw.sha256), sealed read-only
command.needs: SCHOLARCHAIN_LOAD_BASE_URL (loopback http or https) and SCHOLARCHAIN_LOAD_API_KEY in the shell; the ledger created with llm_budget.py init; the include list loaded in the runtime artifact (experiments/inputs/q12/include-ids.txt); P3 (direct coauthor budget) and P4 (path abstentions) fixed

method_note: the runtime artifact is a bounded subset (the include list plus degree-fill up to the row cap), so ranking questions rank only the researchers inside it; the scorer verifies every cited value against the export and reports agreement with the corpus-wide top as information only
open_items: Phase14QuestionSetPlannerSpec equivalent for the 33 questions (rag-engineer): 24 questions are in the fallback grammar; temporal, community and evidence (9) need the planner LLM
no grading of free-form prose beyond the key facts (numbers, names, hop words); the scorer reports every failure reason
